snippet.title: Free Isn't
snippet.description:
Free shipping. Free checking. Free apps. The $1.50 Costco hot dog. Somebody pays for all of it, and it's usually not who you think.

Free Isn't takes one business at a time and finds the bill hiding behind the cheap or free thing. A new receipt every day.

How it's made: every script starts from primary documents, like SEC filings, court records and government data. Every number on screen is checked against its source, and the sources are linked under each video. When a number is our own arithmetic, we say so. The narrator is an AI voice, and every frame is drawn in code by us.

We show who pays. We don't give financial advice.

Some weeks we flip it and price out how the very rich live, like what a superyacht costs just to sit at the dock.

Subscribe if you've ever looked at something and asked "how is this free?"

snippet.title: Hearthside Surnames
snippet.description:
Every last name carries a story. Hearthside Surnames uncovers where family names really come from — the villages, trades, wars and migrations that shaped them, and the people who carried them across centuries.

Each video takes one surname (or a family of names) and traces its origin, meaning, spelling changes and spread around the world, from Britain, Ireland and Germany to Scandinavia, Italy, Eastern Europe and beyond. Sources are listed in every video description so you can dig deeper into your own family history.

New surname stories every week. Don’t see your last name yet? Drop it in the comments — viewer requests shape what we cover next.

Subscribe and pull up a chair by the hearth.
